name: D.C. al Coda
source:
Waiting for her connecting bus, Ella has nothing but time, her own thoughts, and the company of a pianist playing in the flat behind her.

[From [url=https://fumblebaum.itch.io/dc-al-coda]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在等待接驳巴士的过程中，艾拉除了时间、自己的想法，以及身后公寓里一位钢琴家的陪伴之外，一无所有。

[来自[url=https://fumblebaum.itch.io/dc-al-coda]itch.io[/url]]
